messages:
sam: urgent: tokenizer regressing on long prompts in eu-west1 after 2.3 rollout. impacting ~0.8% requests and causing p95 spikes. proposing hotfix v2.3.1-hotfix and a split-rollout: pin eu-west1 to hotfix and leave other regions on 2.3. Need expedited approvals to bypass full canary. change window: 30m starting now. details: https://redwood.internal/releases/2.3.1-hotfix

alejandra: ack. tagging @ops-oncall and @maria for infra signoff. what's the rollback criteria?

maria: @sam thanks — need release note blurb + quick e2e run. Rollback criteria: error rate >0.5% sustained over 5m OR p95 latency >200ms for tokens over 5m. If either happens we rollback. :eyes: 

deploy-bot: deploy request queued by sam: image=registry.redwood/model:v2.3.1-hotfix, target=euw1, strategy=manual-pin, canary=skip-if-expedited. CI e2e=passing. request_id=d4c3f2. ETA ~8m to start.

ops-oncall: oncall here, I approve manual pin to euw1 for 30m window. I will monitor telemetry and take rollback action if thresholds breached. :thumbsup: 

lucy: +1 from product for user impact mitigation. please include this release note blurb: "Fix tokenizer mismatch causing long-prompt regressions and p95 latency spikes in EU."

sam: executing rollout now — running these commands:
```
kubectl set image deploy/model-inference model=registry/redwood/model:v2.3.1-hotfix -n euw1
kubectl annotate deploy/model-inference redwood/release=manual-pin-3123456789 -n euw1
```

deploy-bot: rollout started: 20 pods -> updating in euw1. progress: 5/20 -> 12/20 -> 20/20. healthchecks passing. telemetry update: error_rate -> 0.15% (from 0.8%) after 3m.

maria: monitoring dashboards (logs + fast traces). looks stable so far. continuing 10m watch.

ops-oncall: marking window as active. will extend by +15m if stability holds. :white_check_mark:

sam: closing thread — hotfix pinned in eu-west1, metrics normalized. I'll publish formal rollout summary and add release note. thanks everyone!
